decisions.title: Product name and positioning
decisions.rationale: Owner decision (session): shorter, product-oriented; README already published with this identity.
decisions.reversibility: Fully reversible (renaming later is documentation work); recorded in README-BOOTSTRAP-001 discovery.

decisions.title: MVP retrieval path: Bedrock Knowledge Bases first, backend-agnostic interface
decisions.choice: Both behind one interface, Bedrock-KBs-first for the integrated path, local lexical/embedding retrieval as the offline default for tests
decisions.rationale: Bedrock KBs offer the fastest credible cited-answer path (F1) while keeping the retriever contract backend-agnostic defuses lock-in criticism; tests must run offline, so the local path is the test default.
decisions.reversibility: High: RAG-BACKEND-SPIKE re-validates immediately before MVP-RAG-001; swapping backends touches only the retriever adapter.

decisions.title: Backend stack: Python + FastAPI with pydantic settings and pytest
decisions.choice: FastAPI (+ uvicorn), pydantic settings, pytest, injectable clients
decisions.rationale: Owner stack (5 years experience, target competences: REST, auth, validation, async, tests); harness already tests Python tooling smoothly.
decisions.reversibility: Reversible at MVP scale; later changes would be migration work, so locked for Month 1.

decisions.title: Frontend stack: Next.js minimal (chat + sources + doc list)
decisions.choice: React/Next.js minimal pages, no auth UI in MVP
decisions.rationale: Owner plan (React/Next.js); minimal UI serves demos and dogfooding only for Month 1.

decisions.title: IaC choice deferred to Month-2 with Terraform preferred
decisions.choice: Terraform first (defer final choice), evaluated against CDK at deployment time
decisions.rationale: Owner plan states the choice is made after comparing cost/complexity/requisites; Month-1 has no deployment surface.
decisions.reversibility: Decision is explicitly deferred and reversible now; will harden at COPILOT-PROD sprint planning.

decisions.title: Evaluation is a gate, not a nice-to-have
decisions.choice: Golden Q&A set + JSON report + exit-code threshold integrated in CI from Month 1 (offline path)
decisions.rationale: Owner differentiators demand measurable answer fidelity and regression protection (F2); the harness culture also demands deterministic evidence.

decisions.title: Offline-first testing policy
decisions.choice: All Month-1 tests run offline with fake clients/storage; AWS integration tests gated behind explicit flags
decisions.rationale: Deterministic evidence culture; zero-cost MVP; faster iteration in 8h/week cadence.
decisions.reversibility: Integration tests added per-module when AWS access is available.

2026-11-05 SPIKE RESOLVED (D8): RAG-BACKEND-SPIKE three open questions resolved offline by repo-fact analysis: (S1) local retrieval = deterministic lexical term-overlap scoring, zero deps; chunks = paragraphs split on blank lines, locator '<sha256>--chunk-<n>' (PDF text extraction deferred: only .md/.txt retrievable in MVP, documented in README); (S2) abstention contract = retrieval-only gate BEFORE the LLM: no chunks or best score < THRESHOLD constant -> abstained=true INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE with zero citations and no LLM call; passing evidence -> grounded user prompt composed from cited chunks; (S3) citations = {pointer to doc id/sha256, filename, chunk locator, score}; no section numbers in MVP; (S4) Retriever Protocol (retrieve(question, k) -> list[Chunk]) so Bedrock Knowledge Bases slots in later without changing /answer logic; BedrockLLM.answer has no system kwarg so grounding instructions are folded into the user prompt (llm.py out of this task's file surface). Threshold/TopK values are implementation constants fixed and tested by MVP-RAG-001.
